claim: Reads available identifiers and capture times from selected local image, video, and sidecar files.
sandbox: Fresh browser context; select local image, video, and sidecar fixtures; observe their evidence and group verdicts.

claim: Labels candidate groups as verified, ambiguous, or conflict using available evidence.
sandbox: Fresh /demo load; assert the realistic sample contains one visible group of each verdict.

claim: Never moves, renames, deletes, or changes selected files.
sandbox: Select two temporary source files, run an analysis, then compare their on-disk bytes with the bytes before selection.

claim: Files and report metadata stay on this device; normal analysis sends no cross-origin request.
sandbox: Record every request for a fresh /demo analysis and CSV export; assert every HTTP request is same-origin.

claim: Exports the review as CSV and JSON.
sandbox: Fresh /demo load; download both formats and assert the CSV header/rows and JSON group count.

claim: Restores the latest local report after a refresh.
sandbox: Analyze a fresh local fixture, reload, and assert the saved verified group returns.

claim: Works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: A dedicated fresh browser context loads the app, waits for its service worker, goes offline, then reloads the shell.

claim: A valid Proof Archive license restores access to named local report snapshots.
sandbox: Recorded valid license-verification response; restore a token, analyze fixtures, and save a named snapshot locally.

claim: The labelled iPhone, RAW, and QuickTime corpus separates 90 conflicts and 10 verified groups without an ambiguous or unsafe conflict result.
sandbox: Fresh browser analysis of 100 groups assembled from independently labelled iPhone JPEG, RAW, QuickTime, and sidecar fixtures.
